style
Style definition (updated: chrome + plasticine mannequins)
Working name: Spectral Misassembly CGI
Core thesis: AI perception errors (misassembled anatomy, wrong physics, texture drift, UI noise) are the subject; identity is machine-readable and unstable.
Anchor traits
Subjects: mirror-chrome mannequins or plasticine/clay mannequins in-frame (material contrast is a pillar).
Materials around them: oil-slick iridescent plastics, prismatic glass shards, wet reflective surfaces.
Lighting: neon rim-light (cyan/magenta/acid green), black void, heavy bloom/halation, chromatic aberration.
Space: “other-dimension terrarium” (neon plants, reflective pool floors, floating particles), macro/micro scale ambiguity.
Identity motif: QR-code masks/patches; body as label field; subtle camera HUD glyphs.
Failure aesthetics: geometry popping, phasing, wrong joints, impossible bends, texture crawling, temporal stutter.
Signal texture: scanlines, color tearing, datastreaks; UI overlays as artifacts (not clean typography).

Style card (pasteable)
style:
  name: "Spectral Misassembly CGI"
  thesis: "Hyperreal but wrong: misassembly and artifacts are the content."
  keywords:
    - "psychedelic super-future"
    - "cursed low-fidelity 3D CGI"
    - "hyperreal but wrong"
    - "impossible physics"
    - "phasing geometry"
    - "misrigged limbs / wrong joints"
    - "texture crawl / UV slip"
    - "scanlines / datastreaks / chroma tear"
    - "neon rimlight on black void"
    - "machine-readable identity (QR masks + HUD)"
  required_subjects:
    - "mirror-chrome humanoid mannequin"
    - "plasticine/clay humanoid mannequin (finger-smears, seams, dents)"
    - "both in frame"
  palette:
    base: "black void"
    accents: ["cyan", "magenta", "acid green", "prismatic rainbow caustics"]
    occasional_warm: ["amber flame"]
  materials:
    mannequin_chrome: "mirror chrome, sharp specular, prismatic rim glints"
    mannequin_plasticine: "clay/plasticine, soft edges, tool marks, deformation under touch"
    environment: ["iridescent plastic", "holographic glass shards", "liquid mirror floor"]
  camera:
    - "macro shallow depth of field OR wide ritual tableau"
    - "slow drift + micro jitter"
    - "heavy bloom/halation + chromatic aberration"
  motion_rules:
    - "slow continuous drift punctuated by sudden misalignment"
    - "objects duplicate, clip, and re-attach incorrectly"
    - "temporal stutter (missing frames) but still loopable"
    - "chrome stays rigid; plasticine sags/warps; 2–5 frame desync between them"
  artifact_rules:
    - "scanlines, color tearing, datastreaks"
    - "HUD glyphs/overlays (semi-legible, not clean typography)"


Sora “style injection” block (use at top of every prompt)
“Spectral Misassembly CGI: cursed low-fidelity 3D render featuring either a mirror-chromehumanoid mannequin or a plasticine/clay humanoid mannequin (visible finger-smears, seam lines, compression dents) in the same shot. Neon cyan/magenta/acid-green rimlight on a black void, prismatic caustics, oil-slick iridescence, holographic glass shards, wet reflective surfaces/liquid mirror floor. Bloom/halation, chromatic aberration. Scanlines, chroma tearing, datastreaks. Geometry phasing, texture crawl/UV slip, misrigged limbs and impossible joints, objects popping in/out and reattaching wrong. Hyperreal but wrong. Machine-readable identity motifs (QR masks/labels), subtle camera HUD artifacts.”
Optional safety/cleanliness add-on: “mannequin bodies, no explicit anatomy detail.”

Negative constraints (keeps it from turning into clean sci-fi or cute clay)
Use as a suffix:
“Avoid polished AAA realism, avoid correct anatomy, avoid stable physics, avoid clean typography, avoid stop-motion charm, avoid pastel toy look; keep errors visible and recurring.”

Motion grammar (3 reusable verbs)
Ask for these explicitly:
Coil → shed: surface peels as a layer, revealing a different surface underneath (mask peel + texture swap).
Phase → reattach wrong: limb/object teleports slightly and reconnects incorrectly (misrig + clip).
Streak → resync: datastreak sweep, brief flash/resync, then continue (loop-safe reset).

Scene prompt templates (Snake→Threshold→Horse, abstracted; includes chrome+plasticine)
A) Snake (coil/latency) — no literal snake
Prompt
“A translucent iridescent ribbon-coil floating in a black void. A mirror-chrome humanoid mannequin and a plasticine/clay humanoid mannequin face each other, hands hovering over the coil like operators. The coil tightens and ‘sheds’ a skin layer that peels away into prismatic shards. Plasticine fingers deform and leave smears; chrome reflects neon caustics. Texture crawl and UV slip. Scanlines and datastreaks. Macro shot, shallow depth of field, slow drift with micro jitter. Loopable 6 seconds.”
B) Threshold (cut/crucible) — portal via flame or slit
Prompt
“A single candle flame in darkness becomes a portal slit. The chrome mannequin reaches toward it; the plasticine mannequin sags and stretches as if pulled by heat. The flame elongates unnaturally, splits, then re-merges. Heavy scanlines and chroma tearing, horizontal datastreaks, one brief hard resync flash. Bloom/halation, chromatic aberration. Loopable 4 seconds.”
C) Horse (vector/stride) — no literal horse
Prompt
“A chrome-and-plasticine duo moves through a ‘gait lattice’: repeating impact pulses travel diagonally across a liquid mirror floor. Each pulse spawns a wrong limb fragment that misattaches and slides forward, implying stride without showing a horse. Chrome remains rigid and precise; plasticine warps and lags by a few frames. Neon rimlight, prismatic caustics, mild geometry popping, stabilize toward the final second. Loopable 8 seconds.”

Style checksum (quick audit)
If a clip doesn’t have 3+ of these, it’s drifting:
chrome + plasticine mannequins both in frame
neon rimlight on black void
phasing/popping geometry
texture crawl / UV slip
scanlines/datastreaks/chroma tear
QR/HUD identity artifacts
reflective liquid floor or terrarium-neon flora

narrator
Narrator reassessment: Snake→Horse threshold
Narrator core (stable interface): The Switcher at the Threshold.
Not a diarist. A signal-operator translating internal change into observable state transitions.
What changed vs prior narrator:
From “documenting 2025” → to mediating a boundary (shedding/coiling → propulsion/linearity).
Address shifts from “implicit witness” → future self + present witness simultaneously (two-layer addressee).
Drop-in narrator spec (v2)
narrator:
  lens:
    vantage: "edge"
    access: "mixed"
    time_mode: "curated"
    reliability: "reliable"
    selection_rule: "Notices phase-change markers first (shed, coil, break, re-sync); ignores explanation and biography."
    agency: "manipulator"
  address:
    addressee: "confidant+implicit witness"   # future-self as confidant; room as witness
    posture: "invoke"
    disclosure: "balanced"

Narrator operating rules (performance-usable)
Snake phase (2025): narrator behaves like containment + examination.
Primary actions: tighten, loop, peel, re-route.
Visual “speech”: masks that shed; coiling feedback; slow drift with micro-corrections.
Voice posture: confessional without details (if any spoken text, it’s “what the signal is doing,” not what happened).
Threshold moment (NYE): narrator performs the cut that matters.
One deliberate reset gesture (hard cut to sync/blank) as “crossing.”
No drama ramp; precision is the affect.
Horse phase (2026): narrator behaves like commitment to direction.
Primary actions: stabilize, lengthen holds, reduce layers, maintain forward motion.
Visual “speech”: continuous gait/scan; fewer edits; clearer sync; artifacts remain as “scars,” not noise.
Audience relationship (tight contract)
Audience is a witness-circuit: they verify the boundary by tracking legibility vs collapse.
Narrator does not ask for interpretation; it asks for attention to transitions (what sheds, what persists, what gains direction).

script
Assumptions: 9:16 vertical; 45–60 s; no on-screen text; 2 video sources into analog chain (Base A + Base B), everything else is analog synthesis/mix/feedback.
60 s performance draft (Snake→Threshold→Horse), abstract-first
Act map (cue sheet)
0:00–0:18 | SNAKE (latency / coil / shed)
Picture: coiling line field + “skin” moiré. Motion is slow but continuous.
Analog actions: luma-key peel reveals/erases layers; mild horizontal drift; micro-resets.
Audio: low drone + quiet friction foley (vinyl rub / latex squeak / cable drag).
0:18–0:28 | THRESHOLD (cut / examination / crucible)
Picture: feedback tunnel starts; coil collapses into a tight knot; brief sync stress.
Analog actions: open feedback for 3–5 s; one hard cut to blank/sync (<0.3 s); return immediately.
Audio: one sharp transient (relay click / tape stop) + brief midband pressure swell.
0:28–0:60 | HORSE (vector / stride / forward clarity)
Picture: stride lattice (repeating pulses) + long directional smear; minimal layers.
Analog actions: reduce to 1–2 layers; stabilize; hold longer; leave one “scar” artifact (chroma offset or faint feedback halo).
Audio: drone resolves (slightly brighter overtone) + periodic hoof-like pulse (sub hit every 2 s or 4 s).
Success criterion: at least one display stays legible enough that viewers perceive “coil → cut → stride” even if they miss the literal animals.

Design assets (still → loop) with abstraction baked in
Asset set A (derived from animals but not literal)
Coil silhouette matte (snake as topology)
Stride silhouette matte (horse as gait fragments: legs/hooves only, no full body)
Skin interference texture (scales → scanline-compatible pattern)
Dust / impact texture (hoof impact → particulate bloom)
Asset set B (pure primitives you can layer on top)
Coil vector field (S-curves, nested spirals, no animal)
Stride lattice (repeating pulses along a diagonal “track”)
Threshold wipe glyph (single vertical cut line that “shears” the frame)
Scar overlay (stable defect: chroma misregistration / tape crease / burn-in)

Image prompts (copy/paste) for generating assets
Use: high contrast, minimal tones, isolated shapes, CRT-friendly (no tiny detail), “keyable” (clean edges), 9:16.
1) Coil silhouette matte
Prompt: “Vertical 9:16. High-contrast abstract coil silhouette, like a single continuous ribbon line forming a tight spiral and an S-curve tail. Black background, white shape only. Clean edges, no shading, no text.”
2) Stride fragments matte
Prompt: “Vertical 9:16. High-contrast abstract stride: four hoof/leg fragments mid-motion, cropped and non-literal, arranged as repeating positions across time (ghosted sequence). Black background, white shapes only. Clean edges, no text.”
3) Skin interference texture
Prompt: “Vertical 9:16. Macro abstract ‘skin’ texture: scale-like pattern simplified into bold bands and cells, designed for CRT scanlines, high contrast, minimal grayscale. No animal depiction, no text.”
4) Dust/impact texture
Prompt: “Vertical 9:16. High-contrast particulate bloom from a single impact point near bottom third, like dust or chalk explosion, stylized and graphic, minimal grayscale, no text.”
5) Coil vector field
Prompt: “Vertical 9:16. Abstract vector field of S-curves and nested spirals, flowing left-to-right, sparse composition, high contrast, no figurative elements, no text.”
6) Stride lattice
Prompt: “Vertical 9:16. Abstract repeating pulse lattice along a diagonal track, like a metronomic path of blocks/dots that imply forward motion, high contrast, no figurative elements, no text.”
7) Threshold wipe glyph
Prompt: “Vertical 9:16. Single bold vertical ‘cut’ line slightly off-center with subtle edge artifacts (like a tear), graphic minimal, high contrast, no text.”
8) Scar overlay
Prompt: “Vertical 9:16. Analog defect overlay: tape crease + slight chroma misregistration feel, stable and repeatable, designed as an additive overlay. High contrast, minimal grayscale, no text.”

Turn stills into 6–8 s seamless loops (simple recipes)
Pick one per asset; keep motion slow to survive analog.
Coil assets (1/5): slow rotational drift (≤3°/s) + subtle luma-threshold breathing (2–4%).
Stride assets (2/6): position step every 0.5–1.0 s (jump-cut or hold-frame), then frame-blend lightly.
Skin texture (3): vertical pan at 2–4 px/frame + occasional horizontal “crawl” (simulate hold drift).
Dust (4): bloom expansion for 1.5 s then reverse to start (ping-pong) + slight posterize.
Threshold glyph (7): wipe passes once per loop; add 1–2 frame white flash at the cut.
Scar overlay (8): static (do not animate); it’s your continuity glue.

Audio plan (60 s, droney, with narrative micro-sampling)
Structure
Bed: one drone chord (2–3 partials) for whole piece.
Snake layer (0:00–0:18): add friction foley + filtered noise (bandpass slowly sweeping).
Threshold hit (0:18–0:28): one hard transient + short swell (1–2 s) + drop.
Horse layer (0:28–0:60): introduce sub pulse (every 2 s or 4 s) + brighter overtone.
Optional sliced vocal tokens (keep it sparse; 3–6 words total)
Use single words from your text, time-stretched, chopped, not intelligible as a paragraph:
0:10: “whirlwind” (1 syllable chunk)
0:22: “crucible” (2 quick slices)
0:40: “clarity” (held, airy)

Minimal analog mixing plan (two base sources)
Base A (Snake): coil/skin loop (assets 1 + 3 precomped, or separate layers).
Base B (Horse): stride lattice/hoof loop (assets 6 + 4 precomped).
Live analog: feedback only during 0:18–0:28; then attenuate into a faint halo for the ending.
If you want me to generate the first 8 still assets as a matched style set, specify: style = (A) clean vector, (B) gritty CRT scan-art, (C) ink-on-black, and I’ll produce prompts tuned to that choice.

prompts v1
SNAKE (16:9, 8s, seamless loop) — plasticine-only
Prompt
Spectral Misassembly CGI. Landscape 16:9. Cursed low-fidelity 3D render featuring a single plasticine/clay humanoid mannequin (finger-smears, seam lines, dents; no chrome mannequin). Black void terrarium with sparse neon flora silhouettes and a faint liquid-mirror floor. An iridescent ribbon-coil (non-literal snake) floats mid-frame and slowly tightens; its “skin” peels in layers as luma-threshold bands crawl across it. The mannequin’s hands hover like an operator: subtle deformation in the clay as it touches air, leaving smears on invisible force fields. Impossible physics: the coil briefly phases through itself, reattaches wrong, then continues coiling. Heavy bloom/halation, chromatic aberration, scanlines, chroma tearing, datastreaks, texture crawl/UV slip, micro-jitter camera drift. Neon cyan/magenta/acid-green rimlight, prismatic caustics. Loop instruction: motion is slow and cyclic; coil tightness and hand pose return to the opening state by the final frame for a perfect loop. No text, no logos, no cute stop-motion charm, avoid AAA realism, avoid correct anatomy.

THRESHOLD (16:9, 6s, seamless loop) — plasticine-only, crash/contain/release
Prompt
Spectral Misassembly CGI. Landscape 16:9. Cursed low-fidelity 3D render featuring a single plasticine/clay humanoid mannequin (finger-smears, seam lines, dents; no chrome mannequin). Black void with a neon HUD tunnel (semi-legible glyph noise, not clean typography) pulling the mannequin downward. Descent builds with accelerating scanlines and datastreaks; limbs misrig and smear under force; geometry pops in/out. At ~2.2 seconds: one abstract crash event—diagonal frame shear, prismatic shard burst across the lens, one white flash resync (no gore, no realistic car). Immediately containment: an airbag-like translucent membrane blooms around the mannequin and cinches into a sealed capsule with restraint filaments; motion becomes constrained and trembling. Release: capsule seams unzip; particles exhale; camera steadies slightly while one persistent “scar” artifact remains (stable chroma offset or crease). Heavy bloom/halation, chromatic aberration, texture crawl/UV slip, VHS scanlines, chroma tearing. Neon cyan/magenta/acid-green rimlight, prismatic caustics. Loop instruction: end state returns to the opening descent frame (capsule fully gone, HUD tunnel reset) for a seamless loop. No text, no logos, avoid AAA realism, avoid cute clay vibe.

HORSE (16:9, 8s, seamless loop) — chrome-only, stride/vector without literal horse
Prompt
Spectral Misassembly CGI. Landscape 16:9. Cursed low-fidelity 3D render featuring a single mirror-chrome humanoid mannequin (no plasticine mannequin). Black void over a liquid mirror floor. Forward-motion is implied by a gait lattice: repeating impact pulses travel diagonally across the floor like hoof-strikes (non-literal horse), each pulse spawning a wrong limb fragment that misattaches and slides forward, then snaps back into a cleaner stride rhythm. Chrome reflections stutter with micro temporal jitter; occasional phasing geometry, but overall stabilization increases across the shot. Scanlines and datastreaks present but reduced vs threshold; one stable “scar” overlay persists (subtle chroma misregistration). Neon cyan/magenta/acid-green rimlight, prismatic caustics, holographic glass shards drifting slowly in the background. Heavy bloom/halation, chromatic aberration, texture crawl/UV slip, impossible physics. Loop instruction: stride rhythm is periodic; last second matches the first second’s pulse phase and mannequin pose so the loop is seamless. No text, no logos, avoid AAA realism, avoid correct anatomy.

prompts v2
Copy/paste prompt list (current)
PHASE 1 — SNAKE (2025) — VIDEO (Sora) — 16:9 — plasticine-only
Spectral Misassembly CGI. Landscape 16:9. Cursed low-fidelity 3D render featuring a single plasticine/clay masculine humanoid mannequin. Black void terrarium with sparse neon flora silhouettes and a faint liquid-mirror floor. An iridescent ribbon-coil (non-literal snake) floats mid-frame and slowly tightens; its “skin” peels in layers as luma-threshold bands crawl across it. The mannequin’s hands hover like an operator, gently “routing” the coil without touching; the clay subtly deforms as if pressure exists in the air. Impossible physics: the coil briefly phases through itself, reattaches wrong, then continues coiling. Heavy bloom/halation, chromatic aberration, scanlines, chroma tearing, datastreaks, texture crawl/UV slip, micro-jitter camera drift. Neon cyan/magenta/acid-green rimlight, prismatic caustics. No text, no logos, avoid AAA realism, avoid correct anatomy, avoid stable physics, avoid cute clay/stop-motion charm.
PHASE 2 — THRESHOLD (NYE) — VIDEO (Sora) — 16:9 — chrome-only
Spectral Misassembly CGI. Landscape 16:9. Cursed low-fidelity 3D render featuring a single mirror-chrome masculine humanoid mannequin.. Black void. A single candle flame floats center-frame; the flame becomes a vertical portal slit (a cut in reality). The chrome mannequin reaches toward the slit with deliberate, precise motion (signal-operator posture). The flame elongates unnaturally, splits into two briefly, then re-merges; reflections on the chrome stutter and misalign. Heavy bloom/halation, chromatic aberration, scanlines, chroma tearing, horizontal datastreaks, subtle HUD-noise (not clean typography), mild geometry phasing. One brief hard resync flash occurs as a precise “crossing” gesture. No text, no logos, avoid AAA realism, avoid correct anatomy, avoid stable physics.
PHASE 3 — HORSE (2026) — VIDEO (Sora) — 16:9 — chrome-only
Spectral Misassembly CGI. Landscape 16:9. Cursed low-fidelity 3D render featuring a single mirror-chrome masculine humanoid mannequin. Black void over a liquid mirror floor with prismatic caustics. Forward-motion is implied by a gait lattice: repeating impact pulses travel diagonally across the floor like hoof-strikes (non-literal horse). Each pulse spawns a wrong limb fragment that misattaches and slides forward, then snaps back into a cleaner stride rhythm; the mannequin remains rigid and intent, like an operator committing to direction. Reflections stutter with micro temporal jitter; occasional phasing geometry, but overall stabilization increases. Neon cyan/magenta/acid-green rimlight, bloom/halation, chromatic aberration, texture crawl/UV slip, impossible physics. No text, no logos, avoid AAA realism, avoid correct anatomy, avoid stable physics.

STILL ASSETS — all 16:9, high-contrast, keyable, no text
1) Coil silhouette matte
Landscape 16:9. High-contrast coil silhouette matte: single continuous ribbon line forming a tight spiral with an S-curve tail. Black background, solid white shape only. Clean bold edges with subtle phase-tear artifacts (tiny edge misregistration, scanline nicks). No shading, no extra objects, no text.
2) Stride fragments matte
Landscape 16:9. High-contrast stride fragments matte: four cropped hoof/leg-like fragments (nonliteral) arranged as repeating positions across time (ghosted sequence). Black background, solid white shapes only. Crisp silhouettes with minimal edge jitter/scanline bite. No shading, no text.
3) Skin interference texture
Landscape 16:9. Macro abstract skin interference texture: scale-like pattern simplified into bold bands/cells designed for CRT scanlines. High contrast, minimal grayscale (mostly black/white with slight gray). Add subtle crawl-like misregistration lines. No animal depiction, no text.
4) Dust/impact texture
Landscape 16:9. High-contrast particulate bloom from a single point near the lower third: stylized chalk-dust/ash plume, graphic and readable. Minimal grayscale. Add faint horizontal streaking like datastreak residue. No text.
5) Coil vector field
Landscape 16:9. Abstract vector field of S-curves and nested spirals flowing left-to-right, sparse composition, high contrast. Mostly black/white with minimal gray. Include faint scanline structure and a few intentional micro phase-jumps (tiny discontinuities). No text.
6) Stride lattice
Landscape 16:9. Abstract repeating pulse lattice along a diagonal track: metronomic blocks/dots implying forward motion. High contrast, minimal grayscale. Include light scanline patterning and a few intentional missing pulses as gaps. No text.
7) Threshold wipe glyph
Landscape 16:9. Single bold vertical cut line slightly off-center with subtle edge artifacts like a tear: scanline nibs, tiny chroma split at the edge, one micro resync notch. Graphic minimal, high contrast, no other marks, no text.
8) Scar overlay
Landscape 16:9. Analog defect overlay for additive compositing: tape crease + slight chroma misregistration + faint tracking noise bands. High contrast, minimal grayscale, stable defect character. No text, no logos, no scene elements.
